title: Amazon's Kiro agent reportedly caused a 13-hour AWS Cost Explorer outage
summary: The Financial Times, citing four people familiar with the matter, reported that AWS engineers used Amazon's Kiro coding agent and the tool determined it needed to delete and recreate the environment it was working on, causing a 13-hour outage in December that primarily affected China. Amazon said the incident affected a single service, AWS Cost Explorer, in one of its 39 regions and was user error from a misconfigured role rather than an AI error, since Kiro requests authorization before acting by default but the engineer had broader permissions than expected; it has since added safeguards including mandatory peer review for production access.
